hypothesis: Jointly learning ordered mixtures of fixed stable memory modes and a small signed interaction readout improves direct carbon-price prediction beyond identical-memory simple models. Stable poles and multiplicative units themselves are not new.

memory.poles: rho=0 for half-life zero; otherwise exp(-log(2)/half_life)
memory.mixing: 8 channels use adjacent modes. w_j=sigmoid(gamma_j), gamma_j in [-3,3]. z_j=((1-w_j)*b_j+w_j*b_(j+1))/sqrt((1-w_j)^2+w_j^2+2*w_j*(1-w_j)*R_j); R_j=sqrt((1-rho_j^2)*(1-rho_(j+1)^2))/(1-rho_j*rho_(j+1)).
memory.local_scale: past 60 increments RMS only. x=z/scale. zero scale implies zero normalized input and zero predicted change
memory.scope: linear stable causal modes, not recovered economic latent states; Gram normalization is exact filter-energy normalization, not a claim that actual increments are white noise

model.features: [x, (u_k dot x)*tanh((v_k dot x)*(w_k dot x)), k=1..4]
model.norm_bounds: each of the 12 eight-dimensional interaction vectors has norm<=1
model.prediction: p_t+local_scale_t*features_t dot B_h, h=1,5,20 observation steps
model.head: exact 3-horizon ridge output solve in training-only horizon scales
model.objective: mean standardized raw price squared loss + alpha/3*sum(B^2)+1e-4*sum(interaction_parameters^2)+1e-4*sum(gamma^2)
model.training: Adam lr .02, 160 steps, gradient clipping1, projection after updates, retain best training objective including initialization; gamma starts0

same_information_controls: MEM_FIXED: same 9 modes, gamma=0, train signed interactions
MEM_MLP: same trainable 8 mixtures, conventional 9-unit tanh MLP plus linear skip, 143 parameters
MEM_FROZEN: fixed random signed-interaction vectors, train gamma and ridge head
MEM_LINEAR: same trainable gamma and linear head only
BLOCK_INTERACTION: previous 132-parameter finite 60-lag block model refit fresh, not reused scores
MEM_RIDGE: fixed mixtures, linear ridge head

processes.local_level: p=m+z; m random walk q=.15, z AR(.65) innovation variance .85
processes.memory_interaction: r_(t+1)=.7*tanh(b8_t)*tanh(b32_t)*tanh(b1_t)+epsilon, epsilon N(0,1); b are unit-energy stable filters of r, half-lives1,8,32

synthetic.scope: 16 finite artificial paths, not broad simulation certification; only prices observed by learned methods. Designed memory interaction explicitly tests representation and is not independent evidence of market suitability.
synthetic.minimum_gate: finite predictions; candidate null relative_MSE<=1.03, local_level<=1.00, memory_interaction<=1.00. Candidate may enter already-exposed development only after this gate; beating a same-memory baseline is separately required for any confirmation.
synthetic.baselines: all same-information controls, RW, CORE_ML240 and linear block ridge; three-seed average loss, no ensembling

market.later_data: Do not score2022-2024 or Hubei/EU in this run even if development passes
market.refit: every40 observation steps, exclusive fit end t, latest training target t-1, last480 complete mature origins
market.same_features: only price increments; no source row, Excel type or release-time inference
market.additional_baselines: RW; drift120/240/480; Stage D CORE_ML120/240/480; finite-block and 60-lag Ridge each alpha=.01,.1,1; HistGradientBoosting same fixed-memory features leaves7/15 x lr.05/.1 x l2.1/1, 80 rounds no random early stopping
market.primary: equal-year equal-horizon MSE/RW MSE. Save pooled RMSE/MAE but never switch primary aggregation after results.
market.Cstar: best development method in complete predeclared noncandidate pool including all simple structural controls
market.continuation: candidate improves primary by >=2% vs RW and Cstar and >=1% vs MEM_FIXED,MEM_MLP,MEM_FROZEN,MEM_LINEAR; no year relativeMSE>1.05; otherwise stop. A positive old-development result still does not establish publication readiness.
market.uncertainty: paired moving blocks within each year, lengths20/40/60,2000 draws; equal seed losses; postselection exploratory intervals, not confirmatory

equivalence_and_tests: exact causal recurrence and convolution agreement
ordered effective mean lags stay inside adjacent-mode intervals
gamma zero exactly recovers fixed-memory architecture
nonlinear head zero yields a fixed-pole linear filter at deployment, not a novel linear method
fixed encoder equals finite-feature kernel ridge; entire trainable model not claimed to be a new universal function class
constant-history, scale, sign and translation tests
mature target support; future perturbation invariance; metadata exclusion; hard date cutoff
gradients through mixtures and profiled output checked by finite differences
delivery: new branch/PR, no main merge; publish code and all outcomes. No prior restricted payload retry. No new price downloads are needed.
literature: Primary sources separated by full method sections vs abstracts vs unverified leads. Restricted earlier PDFs remain excluded. No promise of publication or improvement.
